title: Tools
teaser: How AI calculates, searches and acts

basics.say: An LLM on its own can only write text. It can't check today's news, do reliable math or send an email.
Tools fix that. A tool is a function the AI is allowed to call: a calculator, a web search, your calendar.
Ask for 18% of 2,340. Instead of guessing, the AI writes a request to the calculator tool.
The tool does the work and sends back the result: 421.2. The AI then writes its answer using that result.
Tools are what turn a chatbot into an assistant that can look things up and get things done.

deeper.say: The AI doesn't run the tool itself. It asks, the app runs the tool, then hands the result back to the model.
Each tool comes with a short description. The model reads it to decide when that tool is useful.
Tools that change things – sending, deleting, paying – should ask for your confirmation first. Good setups do: that's a feature, not a bug.
Wiring tools in one by one gets messy fast. That's the problem MCP tackles – we'll get there soon.

takeaway: Tools let AI go beyond text: calculate, search and take actions.
